messages:
Asha Patel: hey team, primary for EU overnight (me) stuck at airport, flights delayed. I can't make my 00:00->08:00 shift. Sorry for the late ping. Anyone able to cover primary or shadow?
Diego Morales: Ugh travel. Do you know ETA? can you join remotely at all?
Asha Patel: ETA is honestly TBD, gate said 2+ hours. I'll be online if connectivity holds but can't commit to being primary. Paging oncall-bot to trigger handoff.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT-HANDOFF: shift_primary_change_requested by Asha Patel for schedule 00:00-08:00 EU-night. Please confirm primary/secondary or assign volunteer.
Riley Chen: I can do primary for the first half (00:00-04:00) if someone takes 04:00-08:00. I'm in the US so wake-up might be rough but ok.
Nora Singh: I can take 04:00-08:00 EU, that's early morning for me but manageable.
Diego Morales: Thx both — can you ack and state any oncall blockers? Also Asha, any active incidents or pagers right now?
Asha Patel: No active incidents, last pager cleared 3h ago. Two customers had transient 502s earlier but resolved; full runbooks are up.
Riley Chen: ack — taking primary 00:00-04:00. I'll set status and update rotation.
Nora Singh: ack — will take 04:00-08:00.
Diego Morales: I'll act as secondary for the full window in case Riley or Nora need escalation. Setting myself as deputy in PagerDuty.
Asha Patel: thank you all. Quick runbook pointers:
- If we get token-exhaustion on model-worker: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/runbooks/model-worker-restart -d '{"worker":"<id>"}'`
- For cache stampede: see runbook link https://internal.redwood/runbooks/cache-stampede (TL;DR: enable KV prefix cache and scale pool)
- For customer-impact triage: run `scripts/impact-check --customer <org>` which hits analytics snapshot.
Riley Chen: copying runbook snippets into my notes. Diego, can you post pager escalation numbers for EU infra?
Diego Morales: EU escalation: infra-oncall +44 20 7946 0958, hw-fallover team, and storage lead (pager). Also I'll keep a mirror channel #oncall-live for any long-running bridge.
Nora Singh: question — are we ok with partial API degrade policy? If latency > 1.5s for >5% tokens we open P1?
Diego Morales: yes, follow SLO-ops: if latency breach persists >15min and impacts >5% customers, treat as P1 and pull core SRE. Use incident template in runbook.
Asha Patel: extra note: Dedicated customers on EU-dedicated pool have separate fallback; check their routing keys before doing global failover.
Riley Chen: during my primary window I'll enable extra logging `export LOG_LEVEL=debug` only if we see recurring 500s; remember to turn off after.
Nora Singh: I'll be on Slack and Zoom for handoff at 03:50 UTC to sync state with Riley and Diego. Can someone create a brief handoff message in #oncall-live?
Diego Morales: doing it now.
Diego Morales: @here Handing off primary: Riley Chen 00:00-04:00 UTC; Nora Singh 04:00-08:00 UTC; Diego Morales secondary whole window. Asha temporarily OOO due to travel.
Riley Chen: got it. Quick sanity check — any active canary rollouts currently?
Asha Patel: one canary on model-beta (5% traffic) finishing tomorrow morning; don't promote or rollback unless you see quality/regression alerts. If you must rollback, use `deploy rollback model-beta --to stable-2026-03-14` and notify Product.
Nora Singh: noted. If a pager hits: I'll run `./triage.sh --pager $ID` then follow the impact checklist.
Asha Patel: thanks team, I'll DM PD to update rotation and leave my phone reachable in case of escalation. Appreciate the cover. :heart:
oncall-bot: ROTATION-UPDATE: Riley Chen set as primary 1719998888->171999?; Nora Singh set as primary 171999??->171999?; Diego Morales set as secondary. (automated note)
Diego Morales: small follow-up — Riley, before you enable debug logs, check token usage; debug can spike cost.
Riley Chen: yep will watch token meter. Setting `status: primary-EU-night (temp)` in Slack.
Nora Singh: will join handoff zoom in 10 mins.
Asha Patel: last note — customer-facing incidents: CS is looped in; ticket IDs 8421 & 8423 for the earlier 502s if you need context.
Diego Morales: everyone confirmed. Closing this thread; I'll reopen if anything changes or a pager comes in.
Riley Chen: thanks, safe travels Asha.
Nora Singh: thanks all :thumbsup:
